recipe.name: Heloderma — the beaded one / investment / Silver 925
recipe.calibration_note: Limits inherited from this design; choose a sand recipe to replace them

manufacturing.bench_notes: Procedural half-round keyed to a fat-tail swell, poured in lost wax. A Gila monster lies on the crown: a flat square-snouted head of big domed beads, a fat trunk and a short fat tail in countable bands (high salmon beads, black bands sunk on fine beads), the tail curled back onto the face. The band's hide is one even bead ground, banded by bead size round the shank. A 3 mm spessartite in a collet with a beaded lip in front of the snout. At the bench: burnish the collet's lip over the stone; polish the high beads, leave the sunk bands and the ground satin.
